acceptance: Selection Brier must improve >=1% versus baseline; otherwise stop and record negative result.
Calibrated final Brier improves >=1% with bootstrap upper Brier difference <0; log-loss cannot regress >1%, and supported zone/type slices cannot regress >5% Brier.
Report fixed ten equal-width calibration bins, counts, observed rates, mean probability, ECE and expected-point MAE; final ECE <=0.05. No vendor-equivalent claim.
artifacts: binding.json with release/dataset/source/transform versions, facts and exact game/row membership hashes
exclusions.json including every rejected game and reason
attempts.json with every config, seed, rows/dimensions, peak RSS, wall time and stop reason
baseline-predictions.jsonl and candidate-predictions.jsonl with role and immutable target keys
model artifact, dependency versions and reproduction command
baseline_recipes: Beta(1,1) smoothed training make rate by shot-zones-v1 zone and 2/3 type. Unseen cell falls back to training type rate, then league rate; all references training-only.
calibration_recipe: Within validation season split unique game dates at median date: earlier half selects candidate against baseline, later half fits intercept-only logit calibration. Do not refit on validation. Final predictions frozen after calibration; calibration needs >=1000 attempts and both outcomes, otherwise fail. Probabilities clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6] only for log-loss.
candidate_recipes: One logistic location/type model C=1; one intercept-only logit calibration on validation tail after selection.
estimand: Held-out probability of a made field goal and expected observed field-goal points from shot type and normalized location; free throws and foul value excluded.
exclusions: Exclude scheduled/nonfinal games, mixed phases, duplicate identity/event grains, quarantined games and incompatible source policies.
Exclude rows with unknown required target/exposure fields; absent rows are never zero.
Finalize complete game membership before splitting; never split one game across roles.
feature_recipe: Training-standardized x,y,distance,distance-squared and a 3-point indicator with unpenalized intercept; logistic regression L2 C=1, solver=lbfgs, max_iter=200, no class weighting or player ID. No candidate grid. Reject nonconvergence.
input_gates: Three complete reconciled shot seasons with NBA/event/game identity and shot-zones-v1.
Complete outcomes and jointly valid normalized coordinates/type/distance; correct orientation and observed makes reconcile to final team boxes.
Current release joins have zero eligible shots in the checked 2023-24 scope: source_blocked.
input_grains: unique admitted field-goal attempt with make flag, 2/3-point type, normalized x/y feet and distance
limitations: Historical reconstruction does not establish publication-time availability.
Registered design is not a trained model or a cleared source gate.
Latest seasons previously inspected cannot be advertised as unexposed final tests.
preprocessing_recipe: Fit vocabularies, centering, scaling and reference rates on training only. Unknown validation/final players get zero coefficient plus unsupported flag; no future identity or full-season prior enters an earlier prediction.
sample_policy: >=10000 training and >=1000 attempts each selection/calibration/final; >=30 games per role. Unknown/off-court location excluded and disclosed. Slice summaries require >=200 attempts; unknown coverage retained as exclusions.
selection_metric: Uncalibrated selection-half Brier score; final evaluates both uncalibrated and calibrated frozen probabilities with no final choice.
serving_policy: B26 artifacts are retrospective research only until separately promoted. Show fit/input/calibration horizons; forbid earlier-cutoff decoration by later-fit artifacts. No active points policy, forecast issuance or publication pointer changes.
target_recipe: Binary observed made flag; point target 2*made or 3*made. No vendor expected value, optical tracking or inferred nearest defender.
tie_break: Prefer baseline on equality; otherwise candidate order as listed. No final-test selection.
uncertainty_recipe: 200 game-cluster bootstrap resamples, seed 2501, of Brier/log-loss and expected-point error differences; no shot-level independent bootstrap or individual-shot interval.
units: make probability in [0,1]; expected field-goal points = shot value * probability
